answer: Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The haven panel is drawn blind, the glacier escrow settles at close, and zenith lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 491 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
